name: Szava (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szava: a crowned shield of red and blue with a cross, a bunch of grapes and a church, with yellow and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed 12 SZAVA 90.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szava arms with crown, mantling and scroll
